title: Echo Caverns: Tactical Defense

foundation.history: The underground listening post was built to protect acoustic reflectors, but unstable resonance interrupted its stewardship.

premise: Mira Bryn, a warden, must protect the last community hub using line-of-sight cover while unstable resonance threatens the underground listening post.
central_conflict: a rogue militia seeks control of acoustic reflectors; residents want accountable access.

plot_beats.name: Arrival
plot_beats.cause: unstable resonance isolates the underground listening post
plot_beats.effect: Local routes and witnesses become inaccessible

plot_beats.name: The bargain
plot_beats.cause: a rogue militia offers privileged access to acoustic reflectors
plot_beats.effect: The player must decide whether to share information

plot_beats.name: The remedy
plot_beats.cause: The production plan determines who controls the restored system
plot_beats.effect: Faction trust changes the final public arrangement

endings.consequence: Stewardship passes to a representative public council
Resident cooperatives operate the recovered infrastructure
The essential route survives with unresolved governance debts
